ic_name: HDMI / DVI TMDS (TI TFP410 PanelBus Digital Transmitter — subset)

spec_provided_observability.name: VEN_ID / DEV_ID / REV_ID register read
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Identify silicon presence and revision via I2C (VEN_ID=0x014C, DEV_ID=0x0410).

spec_provided_observability.name: CFG register
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Read DATA[23:16] strap state — gives host visibility into 8 user-defined configuration bits when pixel data is 12-bit.

spec_provided_observability.name: RSEN bit (CTL_2_MODE.RSEN)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Programmable monitor / receiver-sense detection (valid only in DC-coupled systems).

spec_provided_observability.name: HTPLG bit (CTL_2_MODE.HTPLG)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Sample the HPD pin state from the connected display.

spec_provided_observability.name: MDI bit (CTL_2_MODE.MDI)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Interrupt flag indicating a logic-level change on the selected source (RSEN or HTPLG, per TSEL). Write 1 to clear.

spec_provided_observability.name: MSEN pin (programmable output)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Externally observable open-drain output: drive HIGH = MDI / RSEN / HTPLG depending on MSEL[3:1]; allows scope-probe visibility without I2C.

spec_provided_observability.name: H_RES counter
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Read-only horizontal-resolution counter — total pixels between consecutive HSYNC pulses (validates the input video timing).

spec_provided_observability.name: V_RES counter
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Read-only vertical-resolution counter — total lines between consecutive VSYNC pulses.

spec_provided_observability.name: Eye diagram on TMDS pairs
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Lab-bench observability: measure differential swing (400-600 mV single-ended), rise/fall (75-240 ps), intra-pair skew (≤ 50 ps), channel-to-channel skew (≤ 1.2 ns), output clock jitter (≤ 150 ps).

spec_provided_observability.name: DDC EDID read via I2C
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Confirms cable + receiver + DDC path; reads EDID block from receiver at addr 0xA0.

error_detection_mechanisms: PLL lock detect (implicit — when PLL not locked, TMDS output is invalid; receiver loses sync).
Hot-Plug Detect (HTPLG) — receiver-supplied; LOW means display disconnected.
Receiver Sense (RSEN) — DC-only sense; LOW means no powered receiver consuming TMDS current.
MDI interrupt — fires on RSEN or HTPLG change (per TSEL selection).
I2C NAK — standard I2C bus error indicator (e.g. DDC EDID read failure).
Setup/hold violations on IDCK — typically surface as character-encoding errors or eye-diagram failures at the receiver.
Pixel rate outside 25-165 MHz — PLL fails to lock; TMDS undefined; receiver reports loss of lock.
T.M.D.S. character-encoding rule violation (e.g. illegal control-character code) — receiver may discard the offending symbol.
Differential clock used in high-swing mode — spec violation; reduced common-mode noise rejection.
TFADJ resistor open or out of range — V_SWING out of 400-600 mV; eye degraded; receiver may reject input.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: RSEN low-current sense on TX0; in DC-coupled mode only.
Logic-level change on RSEN or HTPLG (per TSEL); latched in MDI bit; cleared by writing 1.
ISEL/RST cycled LOW→HIGH; all registers reset; PD=0.

notes: The TFP410 datasheet provides spec-defined observability via I2C-readable status (RSEN/HTPLG/MDI/H_RES/V_RES/CFG/REV_ID) plus the MSEN open-drain pin for external observation. It does NOT define a JTAG / scan / dedicated BIST architecture — production characterization relies on eye-diagram measurements on the TMDS pairs, IDCK timing-margin sweep, and receiver-side compliance via the DVI / HDMI conformance test suite (DVI Compliance Test Specification, HDMI Compliance Test Specification — both external to the TFP410 datasheet). Vendor display-tester equipment (e.g. Quantum Data 882, Astro VG-870) generates / captures DVI/HDMI test patterns for end-to-end validation.
